> [!WARNING]
> **Early preview.** This is a very early build of SSHeesh. Expect rough edges, missing pieces and bugs. Please [report what breaks](https://github.com/footprintsntrails/ssheesh/issues/new/choose).

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `SSHeesh_{{version}}_universal.dmg` |
| **Windows** 10 and 11 | `SSHeesh_{{version}}_x64-setup.exe` |
| **Linux** | `SSHeesh_{{version}}_amd64.AppImage` or `.deb` |

The app isn't signed by Apple or Microsoft yet, so the first launch needs one extra click:

- **macOS:** [installation guide](https://github.com/footprintsntrails/ssheesh/blob/main/docs/install-macos.md)
- **Windows:** [installation guide](https://github.com/footprintsntrails/ssheesh/blob/main/docs/install-windows.md)

After that, SSHeesh updates itself.
